project_info.theme: User-story minigame around memorable family travel mileage
project_info.color_palette: Soft Sky, Red, Black, Cream, Earth Brown, Warm Skin Tones

main_subject.detail: A family of three gathers around the front of a white Toyota Yaris Cross parked in a mountain field, while giant red handwritten numerals '258,472 KM' dominate the center as the hero statistic of a minigame post.
main_subject.style: Lifestyle social-campaign poster combining real family photography, scrapbook-style notes, handwritten typography, and prize-ticket callouts.

composition_elements.text:
TOYOTA
MINIGAME
CON SO HANH TRINH
258,472 KM
Moi con so la mot cau chuyen
Chia se hanh trinh dang nho cung xe yeu Toyota va rinh qua hap dan!
08 GIAI DAC BIET
Voucher GOT IT tri gia 1.000.000d
YARIS CROSS
Move your world
items: Top Left: Black Toyota logo on light sky.
Top Center: Red ribbon label 'MINIGAME', bold black title 'CON SO HANH TRINH', giant red brush-style number '258,472', and black handwritten subtitle.
Bottom Left: Taped paper note with handwritten campaign copy and a small camera icon.
Bottom Right: White Toyota Yaris Cross with a smiling father, child, and mother interacting around the hood; handwritten white 'Move your world'.
Center/Background: Mountain forest landscape, dry grass field, prize strip at bottom with gift icon, '08 GIAI DAC BIET', and red voucher block 'Voucher GOT IT tri gia 1.000.000d'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft family-lifestyle sunlight, friendly candid expressions, light scrapbook poster polish, and clear text visibility.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Toyota Yaris Cross minigame engagement campaign. Centerpiece is a giant red handwritten mileage number '258,472 KM' over a mountain-road family travel scene with a white Toyota Yaris Cross and a smiling family of three. Background is a forested hill landscape and dry field under bright daylight. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo top left, red ribbon 'MINIGAME', title 'CON SO HANH TRINH', handwritten subtitle 'Moi con so la mot cau chuyen', taped note with call-to-action copy, bottom prize section showing '08 GIAI DAC BIET' and 'Voucher GOT IT tri gia 1.000.000d', and handwritten 'Move your world'. Technical style: photorealistic lifestyle social-campaign poster, warm natural outdoor daylight, scrapbook note styling, clear text visibility, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Keep the exact visible number '258,472 KM' because it is the core hook of the minigame. The tone should feel community-driven and story-sharing, not hard-sell promotional.
